name: 15156-sharegpt-1b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: poisson (OPEN loop), a four-rung rate ladder run back to back against one engine: 60, then 110, then 160, then 240 req/s. Each rung is bounded at 6000 requests with a 900 s safety cap, first 10% warmup and last 10% cooldown by completion. 60 req/s is the rate the item is declared over; the three higher rungs exist because what loads this engine is the rate it RETIRES, and one card's answer to an offered rate is not another's.
workload: guidellm `json_file` over `configs/data/sharegpt-15156-6000.jsonl`, single-turn ShareGPT rows, no shared prefix, one pass per rung. Across the 6000 rows a rung reads: prompt lengths mean 220.35 (min 4, max 1024, 1322102 total), output lengths mean 200.84 (min 4, max 1853, 1205048 total). Each row carries its own output length, so the backend forces ignore_eos and the request generates exactly that many tokens. Requests are RAW PROMPTS -- `request_format: plain`, no chat template applied -- streamed, temperature 0.0.
purpose: A billion-parameter chat assistant streaming short single-turn replies at 60 to 240 requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine command line for item 15156-sharegpt-1b-1gpu, in `vllm serve --config` form.
# The engine is driven IN PROCESS, so the V1 architecture is selected by VLLM_USE_V1=1,
# which configs/tuned.yaml carries -- read the note in that file before dropping it.

# `meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct` re-uploaded ungated (Llama 3.2 Community License);
# config.json matches field for field.
model: unsloth/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
enable-prefix-caching: false

# Cap on RUNNING requests: it must stay well above the steady-state population of this
# open loop or the engine, not the arrival rate, would set the load. Little's law over the
# ladder: ~1.4 s of residency per request puts ~85 resident at 60 req/s and ~225 at 160,
# so the cap is not reached on any rung.
max-num-seqs: 1024

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
